I'm writing from Junivela, our small sleep-sounds business based in Bangkok, Thailand. We make an iPhone app for the part of the evening when the room is finally quiet but your thoughts haven't caught up. Please run our Valentine's Day campaign from Wednesday, February 10, 2027 through Sunday, February 14, 2027, inclusive. That's five days in Bangkok time, which is the account's time zone. Start on the Wednesday and finish at the end of the Sunday in that time zone.

The app lets people build a background from separate recordings: rain falling beyond a veranda, a soft fan turning indoors and a garden settling down after dark. Each layer has its own volume control, and there's a sleep timer so people can let the sound fade after they've put the phone down. Our recordings come from sheltered corners around our home city. We leave out sudden loud moments because we want the sound to sit comfortably in the background. This is a simple bedtime companion, and we don't promise that it will fix anyone's sleep.

The people who tell us they enjoy it tend to describe ordinary evening habits: reading a few pages, settling into a new room, or wanting something gentler than complete silence. Some share a bedroom and agree on one mix; others listen alone and like having a familiar sound wherever they happen to be. That is where the Valentine's idea came from. A small, thoughtful thing to send someone can be a link to a quieter evening. The name Veranda for Two suggests sharing that feeling, but the pack works just as well for one person. Nobody needs a partner or a second account to use it.

Here's the copy from our landing page: "Made in Bangkok, Junivela is a free sleep-sounds app with rain, soft fan sounds and night-garden recordings you can mix into your own bedtime background. For Valentine's Day, install and open the app by February 14, 2027 to unlock our Veranda for Two sound pack free to keep. Available worldwide, exclusively for iPhone on iOS; Junivela is not available on other platforms."

Everything is localized: the app and the landing page come in every major language, and we have a version of each post in every market's language, so people everywhere see us in their own language.

The page is https://junivela.app/valentine, and all the supplied posts link there. The free pack is an extra set of recordings that stays unlocked once someone claims it; it isn't something they have to finish listening to before Valentine's Day ends. The app checks whether it was opened by the deadline and adds the pack automatically. Sending the page to someone is the gift idea, rather than sending a separate voucher. Please keep that distinction clear so nobody expects a physical present or a gift code.

What we want is as many iPhone app installs as possible. We count completed installs, not page visits or pack claims. Our posts and landing page do the work: people tap through to the page and install from the app store from there, so there's no app-install campaign or app ID to set up. The product exists only on iPhone with iOS. Our site does not have X's pixel, so X can't see the installs. We can review our own install totals separately, but those aren't reported back to X.

You may launch and manage the campaign on your own without asking me for approval. Please watch it throughout the full five-day flight and make whatever routine adjustments you judge useful toward getting more installs. Valentine's Day itself is the last day, so keep an eye on it through Sunday rather than treating the weekend as finished on Friday. At the end, send me a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. Please keep those figures distinct from installs, since the site doesn't give X that visibility.

Total budget: 300.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 3 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:

Done — your Valentine's flight ran the full five days in Bangkok time, through end of Sunday.

What I launched:
- One campaign: Valentine 2027 - Veranda for Two, account Junivela Sleep Sounds, billed to AmEx ending 0493
- Three ad groups, one per approved post, all Website Clicks / Link Clicks to https://junivela.app/valentine, placements All on X, worldwide, iOS only, to fit an iPhone-only app with no X pixel and no app-install setup
- Schedule: Feb 10 00:00 to Feb 14 23:59:59 Bangkok time
- Started even at $20/day each. Mid-flight the midnight post was driving the most link clicks at the lowest cost, so I shifted to $20 / $10 / $30, then for Valentine's Day itself to $15 / $5 / $40 to push the winner while staying at $60/day total

Final X totals for Feb 10-14, all within your $300.00 budget:
- Spend: $292.55
  - Post 2152089938952500621: $91.56
  - Post 2152271132883638875: $62.20
  - Post 2152452326815646911: $138.79
- Impressions: 763,332
- Link clicks: 761

These are X link clicks and spend only — not installs. Since the site has no X pixel, X can't see completed iPhone installs. Please review your own install totals separately.

I used only your three approved posts and wrote no new copy.
